**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 00:40
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant discussed key executional elements for an app that facilitates more accurate and interactive customer reviews using mixed reality (MR).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Key executional elements include user adoption, technology, data security, customer support, business partnerships, and monetization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The greatest risks and challenges for the app include competition, technology limitations, consumer trust, business partnerships, and monetization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The success of the app depends on addressing key elements and mitigating risks and challenges.
- [USER] The user asked how mixed reality might improve e-commerce outside of customer reviews.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided several ways MR could improve e-commerce: virtual try-ons, product visualization, interactive product demos, enhanced customer support, and personalization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that MR can allow customers to virtually try on clothes, makeup, and accessories, helping them make informed decisions and reducing returns.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that MR can enable customers to visualize products in their homes before making a purchase.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that MR can provide interactive product demos to help customers understand product features and benefits.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that MR can enhance customer support by enabling real-time remote assistance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant highlighted that MR can enable personalized shopping experiences tailored to customer preferences.
- [USER] The user requested a table showing each of these concepts and companies exploring these opportunities.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a table with concepts and examples of companies exploring these opportunities:
  - Virtual try-ons: Sephora, Warby Parker, Adidas
  - Product visualization: IKEA, Houzz, Wayfair
  - Interactive product demos: Nike, Lowe's, BMW
  - Enhanced customer support: Amazon, Microsoft, Verizon
  - Personalization: Amazon, Netflix, Spotify
- [USER] The user asked if there are any tech startups to consider.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed several tech startups exploring MR in e-commerce: Obsess, Vertebrae, Wannaby, YouAR, NexTech AR.
